finding: A keyless tools/call naming no_such_tool on the Microsoft Learn MCP Server answered HTTP 200 carrying a well-formed JSON-RPC error, code -32602, message "Unknown tool: 'no_such_tool'", on 2026-09-30. This record exists as the control for three others on this entry: it establishes that the server HAS a working JSON-RPC error channel and reaches for it when the tool name is wrong. That is what makes the sibling findings read as "this server does not use its error channel for argument-level refusals" rather than the false and much weaker "this server has no error channel". Nothing here is a defect; it is the measurement the other records are read against.
